title.note: Game title, glossary keep; the guide keeps English game titles.

hud.cast.note: Infinitive button form ('throw'). The fishing idiom 'қармақ салу' is 11 > max 8; on a fishing button 'Лақтыру' reads as casting the line.

hud.bait_left.note: Noun stays singular after a number, so it is correct for 0, 1 and any count.

hud.backpack.note: 'bag', the guide's inventory/backpack word; 'Арқа сөмке' (backpack) is 10/10 and adds nothing on a button.

catch.success.note: Kazakh adjectives never change form and an indefinite object stays nominative, so no suffix touches either placeholder. A capitalized fish name mid-sentence ('Сирек Алтын тұқы ұстадың!') is acceptable.

catch.escaped.note: 'The fish got away...'; generic word for fish as the context allows, since a bare 'Қашып кетті' has no subject.

catch.new_record.note: Developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; Kazakh writes the decimal comma '12,4' (CLDR). Cyrillic 'кг' is the Kazakh unit.

fish.golden_carp.note: тұқы = carp ('сазан' is the wild-carp word, also Kazakh).

fish.lantern_eel.note: шам = lamp/lantern (everyday word), жыланбалық = eel. Keeps the glowing-lantern idea. Alternative 'Шырақ жыланбалық' (more poetic 'light, lamp'); 'Шамшырақ жыланбалық' is 19 > 18.

rarity.mythic.note: Pairs with the guide's Legendary = 'Легендарлы', the same loan pattern kids know from Russian-sphere games, so it reads as the next tier up. Native 'Аңыздық' would clash: аңыз means both legend and myth.

shop.equip.note: 'Use' as an infinitive button; pairs with shop.equipped 'Қолданыста' (in use). 'Жабдықтау' (equip) is formal and 9 chars.

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide's reference form: dative after a hyphen on Robux, short 'алу' for buy since the price sits in the button. 'сатып алу' would be 19/20 and leave no room.

pass.auto_reel.note: авто- + the hud.reel verb тарту, written as one word like автокөлік. 'Автоматты тарту' is 15 > 14. Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Сәтті жем сирек балық ұстау мүмкіндігін екі есе арттырады!
pass.lucky_bait.note: 'Lucky Bait doubles the chance of catching rare fish'; 'your' dropped per the guide. Сәтті follows the guide's 'Сәтті ішірткі' (Lucky Potion).

sell.done.note: Passive 'were sold'; nouns stay singular after numbers, so 1 works. Suffix is on монета, not on {coins}. Developer: if {coins} arrives with comma thousands ('1,250') it reads as a decimal in Kazakh; '1 250' is the local form.

sell.prompt.note: Guide's prompt pattern; Microsoft's 'E пернесін бас' makes it 24 > 21. 'E-ні' is marked unverified with players in the guide. Developer: phone and console players have no E key; ProximityPrompt ActionText 'Сату' alone would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: өрлеу = to rise to a higher level (not climbing, not religious). Kept distinct from the guide's rebirth word 'Қайта туу' because the game names its prestige Ascend. Native check welcome.

ascend.confirm.text: Қазір өрлейсің бе? Басынан бастайсың, бірақ сирек балықтарды {bonus}% жиірек ұстайсың.
ascend.confirm.note: Same Ascend verb as the button. 'Басынан бастайсың' = you start from the beginning. Particle бе written separately. Percent with no space.

weather.storm.text: Дауыл келеді! Сирек балықтар жем қауып жатыр!
weather.storm.note: 'жем қабу' = fish take the bait (Kazakh fishing idiom 'балық қабады'); 'жем' added so it cannot read as biting people. Second '!' matches the excited banner.

quest.catch_n.note: Moonlit Bay translated (glossary) as 'Айлы шығанақ', locative on the place name, not on {n}. Singular after the number works for 1.

friends.boost.text: Достармен бірге балық аулау +{percent}% сәттілік береді

trade.sent.note: Label form so no suffix lands on {player}; the guide's 'деген ойыншыға' pattern makes it 42 > 33. 'Айырбас ұсынысы' (trade offer) is the natural Kazakh for a trade request.

trade.accept.note: '{player} agreed to the trade'; {player} stays nominative as subject, no gender in Kazakh.

codes.redeemed.note: 'Enjoy your reward' rendered with the Kazakh congratulation idiom 'құтты болсын' said over a new gift.

afk.kicked.text: Тым ұзақ қозғалмай тұрдың, сондықтан балық аулау тоқтады.
afk.kicked.note: 'You stood still too long, so fishing stopped.' No mention of leaving the server, as in the source.

settings.sfx.note: Native 'әсер' for effect; 'Дыбыс эффектілері' (17/18) is the loan form, 'Дыбыстар' (sounds) the short one if the row sits beside a music row.

event.ends.note: Colon form from the guide, so no suffix on {time}; 'Іс-шара бітуіне:' is 16 > 14. Developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; Kazakh reads '2 күн 4 сағ'.

daily.streak.text: Қатарынан {day}-күн! Тағы сыйлық алу үшін ертең қайта кел.
daily.streak.note: 'Day {day} in a row!' with the hyphen ordinal, safe for every integer. 'for more' made explicit as more rewards, per the context notes.

tip.night.text: Кеңес: кейбір балықтар тек түнде жем қабады.
tip.night.note: Same 'жем қабу' (take the bait) idiom as weather.storm. Lowercase after the colon per the guide.

group.join.text: Біздің топқа қосылып, 50 тегін жем ал!
group.join.note: Guide's group pattern ('Біздің топқа қосылып, ... ал!'); 'our group' makes clear it is the studio's group.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest fish', since the board ranks by weight; 'Ең ірі балық' (biggest fish) also natural.
